text:
incident-bot: PAGING: runtime-paging-surge on pool-3 (regions: us-west1). elevated gpu memory paging and >5% request latency spike. auto-escalation to oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall_amy: I'm on it. ack. collecting initial metrics from the node group.

lee_sre: grabbing logs from pool-3 pods now. suspecting KV cache churn + large batch tail requests. any customer impact seen?

julie_support: small set of customers reporting slow responses (~10-20s). no errors returned, just high latency. CS notified affected accounts and offered temporary rate limits.

sam_runtime: one quick mitigation: reduce default batch_size on pool-3 from 32 -> 8 and enable aggressive kv_cache_eviction for 15m. will push as a runtime config patch if SRE ok.

lee_sre: do it. also push a kcov capture and GPU memory trace for 5m. share log links here.

sam_runtime: applying patch now:
```bash
# reduce batch size for pool-3
redwoodctl runtime update pool-3 --set batch_size=8 --set kv_cache.eviction_policy=aggressive --ttl 900
```

sam_runtime: patch applied at 1766664352.

incident-bot: Mitigation action recorded: runtime config patch by sam_runtime at 1766664352.

lee_sre: initial GPU stats from node-17 (pre-patch):
```
GPU0: total=48GB, used=41.2GB (85.8%), active_pages=124K
GPU1: total=48GB, used=39.7GB (82.7%), active_pages=119K
kv_cache.size=62GB across shard, eviction_rate=0.3/s
batch_tail_99=28 tokens, p99_latency=6.4s
```

lee_sre: post-patch (2m after):
```
GPU0: used=36.1GB (75.2%), active_pages=98K
GPU1: used=35.9GB (74.8%), active_pages=95K
kv_cache.size=58GB, eviction_rate=1.2/s
batch_tail_99=12 tokens, p99_latency=2.1s
```

oncall_amy: looks like immediate improvement. hold for 20m to ensure not oscillating.

marta_product: any hypothesis on root cause? saw a model rollout yesterday?

sam_runtime: we rolled v2.3.1 quantized model onto pool-3 last night. v2.3.1 increases KV cache entries per request due to longer context overhead. combined with a set of larger batch submissions from a partner app (spike at ~1766664300) likely caused fragmentation and paging.

lee_sre: hypothesis list: 1) model change increased per-request KV footprint, 2) bursty partner traffic increased average batch size causing more KV allocations, 3) eviction policy didn't react fast enough -> paging.

julie_support: flagged partner app owner, they confirmed a batch job ramped up ~1766664295 for internal search indexing.

lee_sre: collecting logs for timeline build. uploading traces to s3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1766664321/traces.tar.gz 

oncall_amy: customer impact: 6 accounts saw degraded latency between 1766664300-1766664380. CS engaged them. no 5xx errors.

sam_runtime: follow-up mitigation options:
- keep batch_size=8 on pool-3 for 24h
- pin pool-3 to previous model v2.3.0 for canary rollback
- tune kv_cache.max_entries and increase eviction swiftness
- add request-level limits for partner job (throttle)

lee_sre: immediate next actions: 1) extend patch TTL to 24h (oncall_amy) 2) coordinate with product/partner for throttles (marta_product & julie_support) 3) start RCA doc and link timeline+logs (lee_sre)

oncall_amy: extended patch applied at 1766664380 (ttl updated).

marta_product: I'll schedule partner call and ask them to throttle indexing job for next 6h.

lee_sre: starting RCA draft: docs/internal/incidents/1766664321-runtime-paging-rca.md (private). will include timeline, GPU traces, config deltas, and mitigation timeline.

julie_support: noted — I'll follow up with affected customers once we have rollback/long-term plan.

sam_runtime: capturing a short experiment to reproduce: ran a synthetic workload with high context + batch=32 against v2.3.1; saw KV growth that triggered paging after ~200 requests. logs uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1766664321/synth.txt

lee_sre: marking incident as mitigated for now. keeping channel open for 1h post-mitigation for stability. good work everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=high -> monitoring, mitigations_applied=[reduce_batch_size, kv_eviction_aggressive], start_ts=1766664300, mitigated_ts=1766664380

oncall_amy: closing timeline note: first spike 1766664300, patch 1766664352, extended 1766664380, monitoring window ends 1766664980.
